about: Every mod The Curse of Alduin plays with in your game, read from your plugins and SKSE folder (Nov 26). For each: what it does for CoA, whether the release needs it, and my pick - keep it, swap it for a better one, make our own, or drop it. Nolvus-level quality comes mostly from lighting, weather, shaders and effects; CoA already has the same backbone (Community Shaders, Lux, Azurite), so the gains are in the places marked below.
groups: The shader engine: light, shadows, parallax.
Keep, and turn on its add-ons: Light Limit Fix (every spell and flask lights the night), Screen-Space GI, Dynamic Cubemaps, Complex Parallax. Lighter than ENB on big nights.
Its lights are made for ENB; with Community Shaders Light Limit Fix does the job. Drop it, or keep only if you go ENB.
The same lighting Nolvus uses. Keep.
Fine for dark nights. NAT III (Nolvus' weather) is the other choice; it's brighter and heavier.
Keep: cities and roads are where the nights happen.
Folkvangr, Cathedral 3D Pine Grass, Origins of Forest, Tamrielic Grass, Veydosebrom, Short Grass, Freak's Floral Fields
Seven grass mods overlap and cost frames on big nights. Keep one main grass set and Landscape Fixes.
Seasons of Skyrim / Seasonal Landscapes, Snow Over Skyrim

Spells; its effects are parts of our abilities.
Keep: many of our ability effects are built from its parts.
Spells; its effects are parts of our abilities.

Bodies burned, frozen or shocked on death.
The Deaths tab's picks replace it with our own deaths; until they're in the game it stays.
Quarterstaffs, rapiers, claws, pikes; their moves.
Keep: class weapons and Tablet weapons use its models and animations.
The wands and the Soulcaller's look.
Keep, or we make our own wand and staff models later.
Only Alduin's Bane uses them. Make our own Bane model (like the Dragon Slayer) and drop both.
Faction Crossbows, Offhand Bows, Bow Charge Plus

The same base Nolvus uses. Keep.

For BO3 movement: keep TDM, replace TK Dodge with our own slide and sprint (see Decisions).
Keep; its slide is a start for ours.
Open/Dynamic Animation Replacer, Behavior Data Injector

The zombies and the Thriceborn bodies.
Keep mihailzombies. His Bone Colossus, Old God, Giant Family, Fogling, High Fantasy and Indrik packs aren't used by CoA.
Not used by CoA's rows now; check before dropping.
